name: Bill Hagerty

on_the_ballot: Running, Republican for U.S. Senate (TN) - Jr

positions.question: Do you generally support pro-choice or pro-life legislation?

evidence.text: "As a father of four, Bill fully appreciates the precious right to life. He’ll always stand up for the most vulnerable among us, and he will protect the rights of the unborn."
"In the United States Senate I will stand up for religious freedom, fight to repeal and replace Obamacare, stop illegal immigration and build the wall, and protect the right to life."
"The @GOP asked the DOJ to investigate Planned Parenthood for fraud. Planned Parenthood stole $80 million dollars of coronavirus-relief funds from small businesses and they must be held accountable."

positions.question: In order to balance the budget, do you support an income tax increase on any tax bracket?

evidence.text: "Tennesseans know firsthand the value of low taxes and small government, and Washington, D.C. could learn a lot from our example. President Trump’s tax cuts are working. Bill believes we need to continue to make the tax code simple, fair, low, and permanent, and he’ll fight to make sure our tax policy encourages job creation and makes our economy globally competitive."

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?
positions.original_question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support entitlement programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "Medicare for All — a key component of their liberal socialist agenda — would wreck health care and put us on a VA style health care system. All while raising our taxes. #DemDebate."

"Medicare for All is the free lunch of the liberal left. Lots of promises but at the end of the day, you’ll lose your health insurance you get at your job, your taxes will be doubled, and you’ll have fewer options. #TNSen #DemDebate."
"Medicare for All - which these Dems proudly support - would eliminate the health insurance you get at your job and double your taxes. We cannot afford these liberal socialists’ agendas."

evidence.text: "He strongly opposes "Common Core" and "No Child Left Behind" and supports significantly decreasing funding for the Department Of Education and shifting that money to the states via block grants."

positions.question: Do you support repealing the 2010 Affordable Care Act ("Obamacare")?

evidence.text: "Bill knows Obamacare reduced patient choice and made health care too expensive to afford. Democrats think that Obamacare did not go far enough and now, they are pushing for socialized medicine that would eliminate our private insurance and lead to rationed care and astronomical costs. He believes the best fix would be to reduce the federal government’s power to make health care decisions for you and to return that power to the patients and the free market."
"In the United States Senate I will stand up for religious freedom, fight to repeal and replace Obamacare, stop illegal immigration and build the wall, and protect the right to life."
